body_markdown: As reported in *Billboard* ’s[Publishers Quarterly](https://www.billboard.com/pro/ella-langley-sony-top-music-publisher-rankings-q3/?bt_ee=CMEj0BYXZ8p5vkZNNrcQLIJTH6wz53WRyw7i-7zSI_8_zqgR2go9YzHjQSpFNK8C&bt_ts=1794237809882) , Reservoir has earned a Top 10 U.S. market share for Q3 2026, coming in at #8 on the Top Radio Airplay evaluation with 0.87% market share. Kehlani’s Grammy-winning single “Folded,” co-written/co-produced by Khris Riddick-Tynes, contributed to the Company’s market share, landing at #12 on the Top Radio Airplay Songs for the quarter.
